text: The smell of sawn timber is everywhere in Harthafen, and so is the sawdust.
why: The village has no timber resource and imports none, and the gap says the sawmill lacks timber, so sawing cannot fill the place with sawdust. text: Carts of rock grind past, their axles complaining.
why: The readers' premise is off: these carts are not arriving (C19477 is about carts reaching the town), and the hamlet's own open-cast mine is printed still extracting with no mark, so rock moving inside the barricades is possible. But the quarry is Stopped and Mining & Quarrying is Impaired, so carts of rock grinding past as everyday traffic is a loose fit for the siege, not a flat falsehood.
